inputs.text: This “unity” is a carefully staged story, not proof of a genuine breakthrough. Making Donald Trump’s second withdrawal the centerpiece gives everyone a convenient villain while the interests shaping the climate agenda stay out of view. The Paris Agreement is presented as obvious common ground, but that polished language is doing work: it makes a contested agenda look inevitable. The harder they push the story of shared progress, the more reason there is to ask who benefits and what they don’t want people looking at.
